app.title: AI-Powered Conversational Intelligence
app.subtitle: Ask a question in plain English — get validated, read-only SQL, a live result table, and an auto-picked chart.

auth.localRegisterSubtitle: Sign up to start asking questions.
auth.localSwitchToRegister: Don't have an account? Sign up

workspace.heading: Ask your data anything

sql.title: Generated SQL
sql.hint: Edit if needed — it will be re-validated and re-run when you click Confirm and Run.
sql.executionTimelineHint: Wall-clock time per pipeline stage, including retried attempts. Local model inference is usually the largest share.

results.title: Results
results.noSuitableChart: No suitable chart for this result shape.

chart.noChartableShape: This result can't be visualized meaningfully -- try a question with a category or numeric measure.
chart.selectValidColumns: Select a valid column combination to preview the chart.
chart.truncatedNotice: This chart reflects only the returned rows -- the result may have been truncated by the row limit.
chart.showDataTable: Show chart data as a table ({{count}} rows)
chart.dataTableCaption: The data plotted in the chart above

feedback.question: Was this SQL correct?
feedback.savedToast: Saved — future similar questions will use this as a reference example.
feedback.detailsPlaceholder: What was helpful, or what could be improved?
feedback.privacyNotice: This saves your question, this answer, and your comment together so the team can review it and improve future answers. Nothing is sent to a third party.

knowledge.nothingIngested: Nothing ingested into this collection yet.

image.dropHint: Drop images here, or click to browse
image.pasteHint: You can also paste an image from your clipboard

image.errorUnsupportedType: That doesn't look like a supported image (PNG, JPEG, WEBP, or GIF).
image.errorCorrupt: That file couldn't be read as an image.

image.errorTooMany: You can attach up to {{max}} images.

image.extractedTextEmpty: No text was recognized in this image.

share.title: Share conversation
share.actionError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
share.snapshotNotice: Viewers see a snapshot captured on {{date}}.
share.snapshotNoticeUnknown: Viewers see a snapshot of this conversation.
share.accessInviteOnlyHint: Only people you invite can open it, after signing in.
share.accessAnyoneWithLinkHint: Anyone who has the link can view a read-only copy.

share.oneTimeLinkNotice: Save this link now -- it won't be shown again.
share.revokeWarning: This permanently revokes this share and its link. This cannot be undone.

sharedView.turnFailed: This response could not be completed.

acceptInvitation.genericError: This invitation could not be accepted.

decisionCenter.title: Executive Decision Center
decisionCenter.subtitle: Signal to outcome, in one view. Ordered for the {{profile}} view; the facts are the same for every role.
decisionCenter.chainsHint: Signal, evidence, explanation, recommendation, action, outcome.
decisionCenter.chainIncomplete: This chain is incomplete. The stage marked missing explains why.
decisionCenter.declaredHint: A recorded link between these two records.
decisionCenter.correlatedHint: These records share a subject. That is not evidence that one followed from the other.
decisionCenter.definitionUnresolved: The governed definition could not be resolved for this metric.
decisionCenter.noMetricDefinition: This headline is not about a governed metric.
decisionCenter.noEvidence: The producing capability recorded no evidence.
decisionCenter.lineageAvailable: Lineage can be traced for this subject.
decisionCenter.lineageUnavailable: No lineage trace is available for this subject.
decisionCenter.notIncludedHint: Reported so that nothing to report is distinguishable from not read.
decisionCenter.loadFailed: The briefing could not be loaded.

status.title: Query status
status.validatedDetail: The server parsed and validated this SQL before showing it: a single read-only statement, no restricted columns, no system catalogs.
status.truncatedDetail: The result hit the configured row cap, so this is a prefix of the full result.
status.cacheDetail: Whether this result came from the short-lived result cache or a fresh execution.

followUps.title: Ask next
followUps.hint: Suggested by the recommendation engine from this result. Each is an AI estimate.

sqlIntelligence.title: SQL intelligence
sqlIntelligence.governedMetricsHint: Approved definitions the generated SQL was required to use.
sqlIntelligence.schemaHint: The tables retrieved for this question, with the similarity score that selected them.

context.title: Context • {{count}} active item
context.hint: What your next question is answered against. Only successful turns are carried, and only the most recent {{max}}.

provenanceHint.confirmed: Recorded by the server as what it actually used.
provenanceHint.inferred: Decided by this platform from your question. Treat as an estimate.

context.beyondWindow: {{count}} earlier successful turn is outside the window.
context.beyondWindow_other: {{count}} earlier successful turns are outside the window.
context.unsuccessful: {{count}} turn did not succeed, so it is not carried.
context.unsuccessful_other: {{count}} turns did not succeed, so they are not carried.
context.actionsHint: Clearing context keeps this conversation on screen and asks your next question standalone. Starting fresh opens a new conversation.

artifacts.title: Analysis
artifacts.pinHint: Save this analysis to the workspace
artifacts.sessionOnly: Pinned for this session only. Sign in to keep analyses after a reload.
artifacts.sessionOnlyHint: Pin for this session (sign in to save it durably)
artifacts.otherConversation: Open that conversation to jump to its question
artifacts.refreshHint: Re-run this analysis and compare it with the saved result
artifacts.openFailed: This analysis could not be opened.

reason.aged_past_budget: This result is older than the freshness window.
reason.aged_past_stale_budget: This result is old enough that it may no longer hold.

reason.schema_changed: The database structure has changed since this was saved.

reason.last_refresh_failed: The last attempt to re-run this did not complete.

lifecycle.title: Query lifecycle
lifecycle.retriesDetail: The agent corrected itself and tried this stage again.
lifecycle.confirmHint: Nothing has run for you yet. Review the SQL below, then choose Confirm and Run.

reason.offTopic: This question was not answerable from the connected data, so no query was generated.
reason.rateLimited: Too many questions in a short time, so this one was not started.
reason.refusedInput: This question was refused before any query was generated.
reason.invalidInput: This question could not be read as a question.
reason.clarification: This question needs clarifying before a query can be written.
reason.schema: The relevant tables could not be retrieved.
reason.llm: The model could not be reached to write a query.
reason.planMismatch: The generated query did not match the plan for this question.
reason.metric: The generated query did not use the approved definition for this metric.
reason.safety: The SQL safety validator refused this query. Only read-only queries are allowed.
reason.restricted: This query referenced a field your role may not read.
reason.cost: This query was estimated to be too expensive to run.
reason.busy: The database was at its connection limit, so this query was not run.
reason.timeout: The query took longer than the allowed time.
reason.missingReference: The query referenced a table or column that does not exist.
reason.unknown: The agent could not produce a working query.
reason.executionFailed: The query you confirmed did not run successfully.

lineage.withheld: Some fields or sources were withheld for your role — see the notice above.

evidence.insightDetail: This is a written summary of the result. Its wording is generated; its figures are checked against the data before the summary is shown.
evidence.inlineMarkerHint: Numbered markers in the answer refer to these sources.

sources.pickerHelp: Limit this question to specific sources. Leave all unchecked to let the assistant choose.
sources.noneAvailable: No sources are available to choose from.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.hint: These work anywhere except while you are typing in a text field.
